policy: Candidate technologies are evaluation inputs, not automatic adoption decisions.

evaluations.name: Model Context Protocol
evaluations.rationale: Use for tool/resource/prompt interfaces where it fits; do not duplicate it in AIX.

evaluations.name: Agent2Agent (A2A)
evaluations.rationale: Map AIX semantics to A2A where semantics overlap; identify only demonstrated gaps.

evaluations.name: JSON Schema 2020-12
evaluations.rationale: Use for initial JSON contract validation and fixtures.

evaluations.name: OpenAPI
evaluations.rationale: Prefer for conventional HTTP APIs rather than inventing API descriptions.

evaluations.name: SPIFFE/SPIRE
evaluations.rationale: Candidate for workload identity and trust-domain federation.

evaluations.name: Open Policy Agent
evaluations.rationale: Candidate policy decision point; keep policy enforcement points explicit.

evaluations.name: Sigstore and SLSA
evaluations.rationale: Candidate for verifiable release provenance and artifact integrity.

evaluations.name: OpenTelemetry
evaluations.rationale: Prefer standard telemetry propagation and semantic conventions.

evaluations.name: CBOR and Protocol Buffers
evaluations.rationale: Do not add binary codecs until JSON prototype measurements demonstrate need.
